contentPattern.structure: Q&A accordion built from a DA sheet (question + answer per row)

config.source: path to a DA sheet ending in .json, e.g. /us/en/faqs/query-index.json (columns: question, answer)

suitableFor: FAQ / questionnaire accordions maintained in a DA sheet

notes: Reads the sheet, builds question/answer rows and delegates to accordion-faq for the native <details> accordion markup/behaviour. DA project, no _model file.
